evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the large pagination's seven items occupy x=12 to 431.7 CSS px inside a 336 px container ending at x=348. The last item is entirely beyond the 360 px screen, and page 5's control is partly beyond it. The document scrollWidth is 433 px. The resulting wider layout also places the fixed header's menu toggle at x=365 to 421, outside the screen. Screenshot: p01-phone-focus-pagination.png; header: p01-phone-00.png.
fix: At phone widths, reduce .pagination-lg .page-link horizontal padding from 24 px to 8 px so all seven items fit within the 336 px container. Keep the pagination's overflow from widening the document.

evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the TYPOGRAPHY heading's text spans x=15 to 371.8 CSS px while its container ends at x=345. Its final glyph is visibly cut by the right screen edge, with 11.8 px of the text outside the screen. The heading uses a 48 px font. Screenshot: p03-phone-focus-typography.png.
fix: Use a smaller responsive heading size at phone widths, such as 42 px or less with the current letter spacing, so the full word fits the 330 px content width.

evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the table is 465.1 CSS px wide, from x=15 to 480.1, inside a 330 px content container. The fourth column starts at x=369.1 and is entirely outside the screen. The preceding column also extends to x=369.1. The document scrollWidth grows to 480 px, producing page-wide horizontal overflow. Screenshot: p03-phone-focus-table.png.
fix: Put this table in a width:100%, max-width:100% responsive wrapper with overflow-x:auto, containing horizontal scrolling within the table. Alternatively, reduce phone cell padding enough for all four columns to fit the content width.

evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the file label is 214.2 CSS px wide. Its Choose file text spans x=47 to 128.2, but the Browse pseudo-element starts at x=111.3 and covers the final 16.8 px of that text. The visible label reads Choose f. At laptop size the text and Browse have a 3.2 px gap. Screenshot: p03-phone-focus-file.png.
fix: At phone widths, reduce the label's left padding and the Browse pseudo-element's horizontal padding from 32 px to 12 px. Reserve space for Browse in the label's right padding so filename text cannot run underneath it.

evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the large pagination's items span x=15 to 433.9 CSS px within a container ending at x=345. Page 5's control extends to x=376.2, and the next-page control occupies x=376.2 to 433.9, entirely outside the screen. Screenshot: p03-phone-focus-pagination.png.
fix: At phone widths, reduce .pagination-lg .page-link horizontal padding from 24 px to 8 px, retaining a single row that fits the available 330 px content width.

evidence: At 360x780 with touch emulation, the sidebar remains 260 CSS px wide and the main panel occupies only x=260 to 360, a width of 100 px. Its first card is only 40 px wide, leaving 10 px for the heading and chart content. Headings extend past the screen, chart labels overlap, and the Tasks table has only an 8 px visible interior despite 898 px of content. This persists throughout the panel's 3259 px scrollable content. Screenshots: p04-phone-00.png and p04-phone-scroll0-1.png through p04-phone-scroll0-4.png.
fix: Add a phone breakpoint that moves the sidebar off canvas by default and gives .main-panel width:100% with no sidebar offset. Retain the full 260 px sidebar alongside the main panel only where the viewport has enough width.
